title: Longest Happy Prefix

solutions.better:
class Solution:
    def longestPrefix(self, s):
        mod, base = 1_000_000_007, 911382323
        pref = suff = 0
        power = 1
        best = 0
        n = len(s)
        for i in range(n - 1):
            pref = (pref * base + ord(s[i])) % mod
            suff = (suff + ord(s[n - 1 - i]) * power) % mod
            power = (power * base) % mod
            length = i + 1
            if pref == suff and s[:length] == s[n - length:]:
                best = length
        return s[:best]
